title: Composition of derived direct images
statement: Let $X\xrightarrow{p}Y\xrightarrow{f}Z$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. On the derived categories of modules [def-pc-derived-direct-image], there is a canonical natural isomorphism $R(f\circ p)_*\cong Rf_*\circ Rp_*:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_Z)$.

proof.text: Apply lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition to the underlying ringed-space morphisms p.toLRSHom.toShHom and f.toLRSHom.toShHom. It supplies a canonical natural isomorphism e from the composite of derived direct images to the derived direct image of their composite, characterized by its right-derived unit equation. Its three derived-category universe parameters are independent, exactly as in the scheme statement.

The abbreviation schemeDerivedDirectImage is the ringed-space construction for the underlying morphism. Forgetting a scheme morphism to a ringed-space morphism preserves composition definitionally. Thus the inverse natural isomorphism e.symm has precisely the desired type. Package it in Nonempty. The Lean proof checks both definitional identifications without rewriting or altering any category instance.
